messages:
Maria: Quick kickoff — we have a soft launch webinar 'Inference Unlocked' next Thurs. Need X + LinkedIn schedule, SDR routing, and a tight benchmark narrative for threads. who can own hero assets?

Sophie: I got this. will create desktop/mobile/caro crops in Figma: https://figma.com/file/abcd/inference-unlocked. will tag with region suffix.

Ash: Draft copy options:
- Short: "Inference Unlocked: reduce inference cost, keep latency predictable. Live demo — RSVP -> [link]"
- Narrative: "Stop guessing on inference. Join our engineering demo to see predictable serving and cost tactics. Q&A included. RSVP -> [link]"

Jake: Short for X, Narrative for LinkedIn carousel. carousel: narrative card then 2 cards with benchmark snapshot + demo screenshot.

Olivia: HubSpot list: "Webinar - Inference Unlocked Q2" (HS_5019). Zapier flow for contact + task exists. SDR slack alert channel: #sdr-leads.

Tomas: SLA: follow up to high-intent registrants within 12h. rotation primary 8am-4pm PST, backup 4pm-12am PST. I'll add playbook to /docs/sdr-playbooks/webinar-inference-unlocked.md.

Maria: Metrics for postmortem: impressions, CTR, registration rate, cost/registration, demo sign rate, thread sentiment, comment time heatmap.

Jake: Posting windows (UTC in calendar): Americas X 15:30 / LinkedIn 17:00; EMEA X 09:00 / LinkedIn 10:30; APAC X 01:00 / LinkedIn 02:30. Stagger regionally and repurpose hero assets.

Sophie: can deliver localized variants (DE/FR/ZH/JP) if final headlines signed off by Tue EOD.

Ash: Engagement plan:
- T0: publish + first 30m real-time replies from community team
- T+4h: product account amplifies with benchmark snapshot
- T+18h: SDR outreach to registrants meeting engagement threshold
- T+48h: nurture with on-demand recording + 1-pager

Olivia: Paid lift proposal: $1.5k total (60% LinkedIn Sponsored, 40% X). target ML infra & platform engineers at mid-market/enterprise. Run after A/B headline winner.

Jake: A/B test idea: data-first headline vs curiosity-first on LinkedIn 50/50. Metric: registration rate. Winner used for paid creative by 24h.

Maria: Scheduler question @social-bot — Buffer or Sprout hooked? need API for programmatic scheduling.

social-bot: Sprout connected for LinkedIn; Buffer connected for X. Both have scheduling APIs. Buffer recommended for thread scheduling; Sprout for carousel. Use UTC timestamps. :robot_face:

Ash: I'll shorten X hooks to <200 chars and add a question to drive replies. final variants by Tue noon.

Tomas: Drafting SDR templates now (2 emails, 1 LinkedIn InMail). Will link into the playbook.

Olivia: I'll set campaign_id=IUQ2_0426 as a hidden HubSpot field and make retargeting audiences for partial signers and pageviews.

Maria: Format decision: X thread (main + 2 follow replies: benchmark + demo tease), LinkedIn single post + carousel. schedule the follow replies ~20m after main.

Jake: Agreed. I'll track A/B and ping when scheduled.

Maria: Action recap: Sophie (assets), Ash (copy), Jake (scheduling + A/B tracking), Olivia (HubSpot & paid), Tomas (SDR playbook). Reconvene Wed 10am PT for final sign-off. Thanks!
